description: Search text inside files with the same regular expressions on every OS

all.description: Include hidden entries and dependency folders such as node_modules

count.description: Print the number of matches in each file

ext.description: Only files with these extensions, such as .ts,.tsx <extensions>

files-only.description: Print only the names of files with a match

limit.description: Show at most this many matching lines; 500 by default <n>

literal.description: Search for the exact text instead of a regular expression

name.description: Only files whose name matches this glob, such as *.config.js <glob>

paths.description: Files, folders or globs to search; the current folder by default

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression, or exact text with --literal

name: files.grep

files.description: Every file with at least one match.

lines.description: Matching lines, trimmed, at most `limit`; only in lines mode.

skipped.description: Binary files and files over 50 MB.

output.description: What a program the command ran printed

truncated.description: Where the result was cut to fit, and how much
